title: Vietjet Return to Vietnam: Perth Fr $360, Sydney Fr $452, Melbourne Fr $459, Brisbane Fr $479 (Hanoi, Da Nang & More) @ BTF
body:
Deal: Vietjet Return to Vietnam: Perth Fr $360, Sydney Fr $452, Melbourne Fr $459, Brisbane Fr $479 (Hanoi, Da Nang & More) @ BTF

[mmrazz] Yes, because Vietnam Airlines and VietJet are the same thing. Ohh… wait… no they aren't.
[mayo88] Just got back from da nang/hoi an, a great place and really nice food. Highly recommend.
Talked to a couple on a tour and they flew vietjet and said the seats were uncomfortable. I flew vietnam airlines and they were good.
Visa was $36~
[not ai] Yeah, it's because Vietjet is a budget airline while Vietnam airline is the equivalent of singapore airline in terms of quality.
[Leonard0880] Anyone has positive experience with Vietnam Customs?
[mayo88] Waited 1hour in the line at SGN airport.
[Darkii] No issues with customs. There was a long wait but you can pay for a "fast pass" if you don't want to wait.
We waited about ~45 mins at Tan Son Nhat but we weren't in a rush.
Loved Vietnam, would recommend 10/10
[not ai] As others have said, the issue isnt really with customs but more just significant long wait times getting through customs.
[timhn] Vietnam customs: done in 2-3 mins after handover your passport & visa. No need exchange words/pleasantries with them - most of them didn't bother reply to your "Hello/Hi", some just nodded their heads.
Queue before reached customs: 0.5hr - 1.5hrs depending the arrival time
[Codybyrne] Flew Recently with Vietjet Air
Inbound no problems. It is cramped but we could choose the exit row at no extra cost. Surprisingly there is also power outlets in the seats.
Coming back they are absolutely MILITANT about the weight limits. Despite us having 40kg of luggage each, it was not acceptable to have 2 x suitcases that exceeded this (despite overall our combined weight was about 70kg)
They also militantly enforce the 7kg limit. They also weigh your bags at the boarding gate. Was a bit F'd up tbh.
[Maque] I also flew VietJet recently - no power outlets in the majority of seats. I think exits rows were the exception. Agree cramped seating. On-plane service was (Vietnamese) cash only - but reasonable prices.
[TheMindsetTraveller] Have flown VJ like a dozen times this year, its budget and gets one from A to B without too much dramas - except the one time, due to weather I got screwed up big time, and spent 40hours at SGN airside because the next flight was in 2 nights time, and I didn't have a visa to enter the country that one time LOL
